Rule.Name: NF007.1: No prefix for Input

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Formal parameters of blocks are used without prefixes.

Rule.Name: NF007.1: No prefix for Output

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Formal parameters of blocks are used without prefixes.

Rule.Name: NF007.2: No prefix for InOut

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Formal parameters of blocks are used without prefixes.

Rule.Name: NF007.3: No prefix for Constant

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: User constants do not get a prefix because UPPER_CASING already identifies them as constants.

Rule.Name: NF007.3: No prefix for PLC tag table user constant

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: User constants do not get a prefix because UPPER_CASING already identifies them as constants.

Rule.Name: NF007.5: Prefix for Temp

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Temporary variables carry the prefix "temp". This measure makes it easier for the programmer to distinguish between formal parameters and local data.

Rule.Name: NF007.6: Prefix for Static

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Static variables, excluding multi-instances, carry a prefix "stat" (e.g. statState).

Rule.Name: NF007.6: No prefix for Global DB member

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Neither global DBs nor the contained elements get a prefix.

Rule.Name: NF007.8: Prefix for parameter instance

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Parameter instances carry a prefix "inst" (e.g. instSensor). The prefixes make it easier to see if instance data has been accessed (illegally).

Rule.Name: NF007.8: Prefix for parameter instance array

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Parameter instances carry a prefix "inst" (e.g. instSensors). The prefixes make it easier to see if instance data has been accessed (illegally).

Rule.Name: NF007.8: Prefix for multi instance

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Multi-instances carry a prefix "inst" (e.g. instSensor). The prefixes make it easier to see if instance data has been accessed (illegally).

Rule.Name: NF007.8: Prefix for multi instance array

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Multi instances carry a prefix "inst" (e.g. instSensors). The prefixes make it easier to see if instance data has been accessed (illegally).

Rule.Name: NF007.9: No prefix for Global DB

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Neither global DBs nor the contained elements get a prefix.

Rule.Name: NF007.9: Prefix for Instance DB

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: Single instances DBs get the prefix “Inst” (e.g. InstConveyorFeed). The prefixes make it easier to see if instance data has been accessed (illegally).

Rule.Name: NF007.10: No prefix for PLC data type member

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: The individual elements inside a PLC data type do not get a prefix.

Rule.Name: NF007.10: Prefix for PLC data type

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: A PLC data type gets the prefix “type” (e.g. typeDiagnostics). The individual elements inside the PLC data type do not get a prefix.

Rule.Name: NF007.12: Prefix for PLC data type in Library "L<Name>_type"

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Rule: A PLC data type in the library gets the prefix “L<Name>_type” (e.g. LBC_typeDiagnostics). The individual elements inside the PLC data type do not get a prefix.

Rule.Name: NF008: UPPER_CASING for Constant

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The names for local constants are written completely with capital letters (UPPER_CASING). An underscore shall be used for seperation of words.

Rule.Name: NF008: UPPER_CASING for PLC Tag table user constant

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The names for global user constants are written completely with capital letters (UPPER_CASING). An underscore shall be used for seperation of words.

Rule.Name: SE003: Automatic ENO for Code block

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The use of the EN/ ENO mechanism avoids unexpected program interruptions. The block status is passed on in the format of a Boolean variable. Please note: Safety blocks will throw the error even if ENO is not allowed.

Rule.Name: SE004.2: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API writability is set selectively for Output

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Per default the access to formal parameters per HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API shall be disabled. Enable it selectively.

Rule.Name: SE004.5: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API accessibility is set for Static

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The access to static variables of a FB is not permitted. Formal paramters for read or write access must be created.

Rule.Name: SE004.5: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API visiblity is set for Static

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The access to static variables of a FB is not permitted. Formal paramters for read or write access must be created.

Rule.Name: SE004.5: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API writability is set for Static

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: The access to static variables of a FB is not permitted. Formal paramters for read or write access must be created.

Rule.Name: SE004.8: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API accessibility is set for Global DB member

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Per default the access to data block members per HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API shall be disabled. Enable it selectively.

Rule.Name: SE004.8: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API visiblity is set for Global DB member

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Per default the access to data block members per HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API shall be disabled. Enable it selectively.

Rule.Name: SE004.8: HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API writability is set for Global DB member

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Per default the access to data block members per HMI/ OPC UA/ Web API shall be disabled. Enable it selectively.

Rule.Name: DA003.1: Auto numbering for Function

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Blocks (FC, FB, DB, TO) shall only be delivered with auto numbering turned on. Be aware that the execution of an Organization blocks depends on its number/ priority.

Rule.Name: DA003.1: Auto numbering for Function Block

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Blocks (FC, FB, DB, TO) shall only be delivered with auto numbering turned on. Be aware that the execution of an Organization blocks depends on its number/ priority.

Rule.Name: DA003.1: OB numbering

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: OB number need to be adjusted for call sequence

Rule.Name: DA003.1: Auto numbering for Global DB

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Blocks (OB, FC, FB, DB, TO) shall only be delivered with auto numbering turned on. Be aware that the execution of an Organization blocks depends on its number/ priority.

Rule.Name: DA003.1: Auto numbering for Instance DB

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: Blocks (OB, FC, FB, DB, TO) shall only be delivered with auto numbering turned on. Be aware that the execution of an Organization blocks depends on its number/ priority.

Rule.Name: DA003.2: IEC check for Code block

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: To ensure the IEC conformant programming, the IEC check must be turned on. Only this way a type conformant and type safe programming can be ensured.

Rule.Name: DA003.3: Optimized access for Code block

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: For full symbolic programming and the maximum performance, the optimized access to blocks must be activated.

Rule.Name: DA003.3: Optimized access for Global DB

Rule.Name: DA003.3: Optimized access for Instance DB

Rule.Name: PE004: Avoid formal parameter "Variant"

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: This prevents code fragments that are not are needed (“dead code”), since the mode parameter is usually connected statically. Instead, you should distribute the functionalities to individual modules.

Rule.Name: PE005: Avoid formal parameter "mode"

RuleAttribute.Name: Comment
RuleAttribute.Value: This prevents code fragments that are not are needed (“dead code”), since the mode parameter is usually connected statically. Instead, you should distribute the functionalities to individual modules.
